recipes.name: wt-status

hints.match: is already (checked out|used by worktree) at
hints.hint: A branch can be checked out in one worktree only. Work in that worktree, or make a new branch: git worktree add <folder> -b <new-branch>

hints.match: contains modified or untracked files, use --force
hints.hint: The worktree has changes. Commit or copy them first; --force deletes them for good

hints.match: is a missing but (already registered|locked) worktree
hints.hint: The folder was deleted by hand but git still lists it. Run git worktree prune, then add again

hints.match: Cannot delete branch '[^']+' (checked out|used by worktree) at
hints.hint: Remove the worktree that has this branch first: git worktree remove <folder>, then delete the branch
This worktree points at a main repo that moved. From the main repo run: git worktree repair <folder>
Every worktree of a repo shares one stash list, so another worktree may have pushed on top. Check git stash list and name the entry by its message or hash
